think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed values from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether it is a numeric knob with an inherent ordering. 3) If numeric, look for sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that trigger a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior) compared to ordinary numeric scaling. 4) If the knob is not numeric (e.g., enum/string), or has no sentinel numeric values that break ordering, classify it as not a special numerical knob. 5) If special, list the sentinel value(s); otherwise set special_value to null.
